summary: Wynn Resorts, Limited reported that indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries Wynn Resorts Finance, LLC and Wynn Resorts Capital Corp. issued $900 million of 6.875% senior notes due March 15, 2035 under a September 22, 2026 indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. Net proceeds plus cash on hand fully redeem the 5.250% senior notes due 2027. Notes are guaranteed by domestic subsidiary guarantors sharing the existing credit facility guarantee group, with gaming-regulator redemption provisions, 101% change-of-control put, and sale-leaseback and lien covenants. This is ordinary debt refinancing, not a special situation; arbitrage angle centers on leverage and maturity extension.
